name: inlab-human
description: In-lab human evaluation of deployed prediction endpoints — the Claude Code chat is the reader UI. A clinician reviews de-identified cases in a blind→assisted protocol: estimate risk from raw data alone, then see the model's score + SHAP + agent narrative and re-estimate. Skills freeze a review_bundle.json (case → endpoint-predict MCP tool → narrator agent), run the structured reading session (responses.jsonl), and report decision-influence metrics against gold outcomes. Endpoint-agnostic: any JSON-payload endpoint (local FastAPI, Databricks, SageMaker) is a config, not code.
